results.title: streaming deltas actually arrive
results.catalogRow: §2 first turn a viewer joins streams (codex proven; grok/opencode wired)

control.what: transcriptDelta — the DURABLE plane, on the same socket and the same subscription

results.summary: the turn had already finished when the chat opened (phase=idle)
evidence: JOINED            8717ms after the send, and the session was already phase=idle
The ordering under test is a viewer arriving DURING a turn. This agent
answered inside the join delay, so there was no in-flight turn to watch
and a preview count of zero is a fact about the timing, not the plane.
BLOCKED rather than FAIL: re-run with a longer prompt or a shorter join
delay (P2777_JOIN_MS) to measure this cell on this harness.

results.title: resume after a kill
results.catalogRow: §4 resume() brings the CONVERSATION back, not just the ref (proven)

control.what: a conversation existing to restore — the pre-park turn answered with the secret
control.detail: the session repeated REMEMBER-ZC8RLX before it was parked

results.summary: resumed, but the conversation did not come back
evidence: SECRET            REMEMBER-ZC8RLX — spoken only in the pre-kill conversation
HIBERNATE         {"ok":true}; PARKED after 121ms (status=hibernated)
RESURRECT         {"ok":true}
→ back live?    YES after 1096ms
RESUMEANDSEND     {"ok":true,"disposition":"delivered"}
→ back live?    YES after 225ms
TWO VERBS         POD-2775 fixed resumeAndSend, not resurrect. A probe that drove
only resurrect would report that landed fix as broken.
RECALL            the secret never came back
SAME CONVERSATION YES — pointer conv_2b4e4e59-cbab-4a2f- unchanged across the park
ORIGINAL EXCHANGE present — the transcript still carries the prompt that planted the secret
WHY THREE CHECKS  a resume mutated to a STRANGER'S thread id passed 269 tests,
partly because the drive-level check was "both strings appear".
Containing the word is not being the conversation.
WHY THIS SHAPE    a healthy BLANK session carrying the old ref passes any
check that only asks whether resume returned ok.
NOT COVERED       recovery from an UNCLEAN death. sessions.kill REMOVES the row
(resurrect then answers 'unknown session'), so this drives the
hibernate/resurrect round trip a person actually performs.
